Since 2008, we have been helping companies and organisations to accommodate their people when they are on the move for business. We specialise in providing tailored serviced accommodation – whether it's for project teams, corporate travellers, relocation assignees, or global nomads. They're all people on the move who need to find somewhere to call home – when they aren’t at home. That’s what we do all day every day – work to make finding and booking serviced accommodation effortless. About Situ Situ Accreditations and Awards Careers ESG and Sustainability Resources Frequently Asked Questions Where we're based With offices across Europe, the Americas, and APAC, Situ operates as a truly global accommodation agency. Our headquarters are in Exeter, United Kingdom, where our central operations team works alongside colleagues in our international offices to support organisations around the world with business travel and relocation accommodation. Our roots Our founder, Phil, spent many years working in international hospitality and the global corporate housing sector. His experiences led him to set up Situ in 2008, to resolve the cumbersome processes he experienced while searching for, booking, and managing corporate housing across the world. The rest, as they say, is history. Today, Situ is a modern, thriving global accommodation agency with bespoke technology solutions, an incredible team of industry experts, an unrivalled worldwide accommodation offering, and a fierce pride in its down-to-earth and transparent approach. Find your ideal business stay with Situ In one single point of connection we have brought together an unrivalled network of quality serviced accommodation spanning every corner of the globe. Whether it's a quick business trip, a long-term assignment, or a full relocation, we can provide you with serviced apartments, houses, or aparthotels to suit each and every requirement. Want to see what makes Situ the perfect solution for your corporate accommodation needs? Take a look at our 'Clients We Work With' page and discover how we can help. Accreditations We are immensely proud to have achieved and accomplished what we have so far within our industry. However, for us, the sky's the limit. Situ is a serviced accommodation provider with a strong focus on technology and innovation. At the heart of this is Xenia – our proprietary platform, purpose-built to meet the real-world needs of business travel and relocation. Unlike off-the-shelf booking portals, Xenia combines live availability, direct integrations, comprehensive reporting, and advanced security features – giving businesses proven scalability, flexibility, and control, no matter the complexity of the booking. It’s designed to make managing serviced accommodation simpler and smarter, keeping feature-rich user experience at its core. Learn more Got any more questions about who we are, or what we do?
